projects.title: Enterprise Crypto Data Lake: Multi-Account Ingestion
projects.description: End-to-end architecture for ingesting transactional data from 50+ sub-accounts. I implemented an asynchronous extraction engine with an intelligent Rate Limiter (BinanceGuard) that monitors API headers to avoid bans. The system uses Azure Key Vault for secret management and a high-performance PostgreSQL loader via COPY commands and temporary tables, ensuring idempotency and integrity at scale.

caseStudy.problem: Aggressive API limits and credential management for 50+ simultaneous accounts.
caseStudy.solution: Header-based rate limiting using official API data and bulk inserts via io.StringIO.
caseStudy.impact: >99.9% pipeline uptime and ingestion of millions of historical records.

projects.title: Unified Multi-Chain Ledger Integrator (BRZ)
projects.description: Transactional data consolidation pipeline across 17+ blockchains (Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, etc.). I designed an event-fetching engine via RPC with a checkpointing system in Azure Blob Storage to ensure no transaction is lost in case of node failure, unifying the data into a canonical relational schema.

projects.title: Predictive Pipeline and ML Engine (LoL)
projects.description: End-to-end automated system that ingests data via large-scale web scraping, processes 42 engineered features, and performs model retraining. The key differentiator is the automated data pipeline that feeds real-time inference, maintaining 68% accuracy through automated backfill cycles.
